name: menubar
description: A source-owned Dioxus menubar backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; coordinated multi-menu roving-focus keyboard navigation and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.
documentation.accessibility: `role="menubar"` roving-focus container of `role="menu"` menus, each opened by a `role="menuitem"` trigger, per the WAI-ARIA APG Menubar pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/menubar.rs`). Deliberately independent of the shared `menu` primitive -- Base UI's own `Menubar` shares only a roving-focus container with `Menu`, not `Content`/`Item`.
documentation.keyboard: Only one menu is open at a time; `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight` move focus between menu triggers (open or not); Enter/Space/ArrowDown open the focused menu.
